test_title: PYST 5: SSC CPO - Reasoning(Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘PAINT’ is written as ‘ODYTN’ and 'BRUSH' is written as 'CMMOZ'. How will ‘HOUSE’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position and positional value of English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘PAINT’ is written as ‘ODYTN’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dc42c9fadd78916f862f42455632560408367ebb61255b12f92136697aec848.png] 

For, 'BRUSH' is written as 'CMMOZ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a1e6ffa46ebf46296c8a0fcf5cb678dd450d2ccbb5d6f1c1e525930cc8a4211.png] 

Similarly, For 'HOUSE'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3601bfabe992ecad381d33024473cea8df3830046dccd8e7facddb1e20927864.png] 

So, **'HOUSE'** will be written as **'WPMOC'**.

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 2'.***
